info.name: Batman Forever
info.plot: Due criminali funestano Gotham City: "Due Facce", magistrato deturpato e impazzito, e l'Enigmista, scienziato folle e geniale con l'ossessione degli indovinelli. Bruce Wayne, alias Batman, rivive i propri traumi infantili quando la famiglia del giovane trapezista Dick Grayson viene decimata da "Due Facce", ma per fortuna interviene l'incandescente psicanalista Chase Meridian. Alla fine Dick diventerà Robin per affiancare Batman nella resa dei conti.

Batman faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face, and the Riddler, a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also copes with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian.
translations.tagline: Courage now, truth always, Batman forever!
